title: Enterprise 10.4 TLS removal and temporary opt-in descriptions differ
problem: The Enterprise 10.4 upgrade section says TLS 1.0 and 1.1 were completely removed. The versioned 10.4 configuration guide says they are off by default and gives a temporary opt-in. The 10.6 upgrade section says the temporary option was also removed. Preserve the historical evidence and do not treat the opt-in as a currently validated route or apply the borrowed Enterprise section to UF.

products: Splunk Enterprise and applicable Heavy Forwarder components

exclusions: No unlisted exact pairing, rollout, entitlement or customer authorization established.

scopeComparison: Both 10.4 Help articles describe legacy inter-component TLS behavior. Preserve the separately versioned 10.6 removal statement.

impact.consequence: A presumed legacy TLS path may fail and interrupt forwarding.
